task_description: Add sandbox-only file path whitelist to CodeExecutorTool to block access to /proc, /etc, /sys, /var and prevent path traversal in export_files.

scope.rationale: Primary change is one new static method in code_executor_tool.py plus one call site. Secondary call site in WorkspaceScriptRunner. New test file. 2-3 files total.

complexity.rationale: Path normalization and traversal detection require careful ordering: absolute-path reject, os.path.normpath, workdir-containment check, blocked-prefix check. Edge cases (double-slash, symlinks) need thought but the algorithm is well-understood.

risk.rationale: Security-sensitive code: a missed edge case (symlinks, double-slash join, relative absolute path joining) could leave the gap open. But the blast radius of getting it wrong is contained to sandbox execution only.

integration.rationale: Touches only the Code Executor module. No database, no API layer, no external service changes. Both JOBS and SHARED paths covered by one injection point.

test_coverage.rationale: 13 new test cases needed: allowed paths, all 4 blocked dirs, nested, path traversal in/out of workdir, absolute paths, None/empty inputs, JOBS mode confirmation.

uncertainty.rationale: Problem space is well-understood. Technical analysis identifies the exact injection point and algorithm. No ambiguity in requirements.
